## Rick Jung

### Tenure

[2017](/wiki/2017)

**Rick Jung** is a former [Hot Wheels](/wiki/Hot_Wheels) designer who interned for [Mattel](/wiki/Mattel) for seven months from June to December of [2017](/wiki/2017) who went on to work for Mazda North America. He currently works for Jacques Marie Mage and designs eyewear and eye protection.
